info.title: WalkScape Tools API
info.description:
API for accessing WalkScape game data including items, skills, activities, locations, and more. This is a read-only API that serves processed game data files and locales.

All endpoints that return localized data support the `Accept-Language` header. Use the language selector in the top bar to set the language for test requests. Defaults to `en` if not specified.
